title.en: Badenoch urges Burnham to cancel prisoners’ early release scheme – UK politics live
title.zh: 巴德诺赫敦促伯纳姆取消囚犯提前释放计划——英国政治直播

summary.en: A Conservative party leader has urged a Labour official to cancel a prisoner early release scheme, arguing that it allows too many serious offenders to be freed prematurely.
summary.zh: 一位保守党领袖敦促工党官员取消一项囚犯提前释放计划，认为该计划允许过多重罪犯过早获释。

body.en: The Conservative party leader said that Labour’s plan allows for too many serious offenders to be freed early Reform UK has issued its response to Andy Burnham’s proposal for more localised, vocational education. It is in the form of a statement from Suella Braverman , the former Tory home secretary who is now Reform’s education spokesperson. She is a bit more positive about it than her old party. (See 9.16am .) She says: Reform UK has long argued that Britain needs a technical and vocational renaissance alongside a genuine skills revolution. For too long, the philosopher has been valued more than the plumber. We welcome any effort to rebalance the scales, but we’ve been here before. Successive prime ministers have promised parity of esteem and failed to deliver. Spot the difference: “A new ‘T-level’ system, which overhauls how technical education is taught and administered, aims to put the courses on an equal footing with academic work,” announced in Philip Hammond’s 2017 budget … “We need finally to do what we always promise we will — to elevate practical and technical qualifications, so that we recognize their immense value to society and to the individual,” Boris Johnson, 2019 … “Technical education is not given the respect it deserves but today, I am changing all of that, pulling one of the biggest levers we have to change the direction of our country,” Rishi Sunak in 2023 as he announced plans for a British baccalaureate … “While you will never hear me denigrate the aspiration to go to university, I don’t think the way we currently measure success in education — that ambition to get 50 per cent of kids to uni — I don’t think that’s right for our times,” Keir Starmer, 2025 … “That’s why today we’re putting technical education back where it belongs — not as a second thought, but as a first choice,” Andy Burnham, 2026 . The home secretary [Shabana Mahmood] has brought forward a very rigorous plan in relation to this, and let’s remember, the numbers can fluctuate but overall boat crossings are down, down quite significantly year on year. So that does suggest that the plan is working. The public wants to see control being exerted, and while we’ve made progress, there is more to do, and I recognise that completely. But the trend is down, and the number of people being removed is up, so the figures are pointing in a better direction. But there is much more to do. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这位保守党领袖表示，工党的计划允许太多严重犯罪者提前获释。改革英国已对安迪·伯纳姆提出的更加本地化的职业教育提案做出回应。这是前保守党内政大臣苏埃拉·布雷弗曼 (Suella Braverman) 的一份声明，她现在是改革党的教育发言人。她对此比她以前的聚会更积极一些。 （见上午 9.16 点。）她说：英国改革组织长期以来一直认为，英国需要技术和职业复兴以及真正的技能革命。长期以来，哲学家比水管工更受重视。我们欢迎任何重新平衡天平的努力，但我们以前就遇到过这种情况。历任总理都承诺给予平等尊重，但都未能兑现。找出区别：“新的‘T 级’系统彻底改革了技术教育的教学和管理方式，旨在使课程与学术工作处于平等地位，”菲利普·哈蒙德 (Philip Hammond) 2017 年预算中宣布……“我们最终需要做我们一直承诺的事情——提高实践和技术资格，以便我们认识到它们对社会和个人的巨大价值，”鲍里斯·约翰逊 (Boris Johnson)，2019 年……“技术教育没有得到应有的尊重但今天，我正在改变这一切，拉动我们必须改变国家方向的最大杠杆之一，”里希·苏纳克 (Rishi Sunak) 在 2023 年宣布英国学士学位计划时说。 2025 年……“这就是为什么今天我们将技术教育放回到它所属的位置——不是作为第二个想法，而是作为首选，”Andy Burnham，2026 年。内政大臣[沙巴纳·马哈茂德]对此提出了一项非常严格的计划，让我们记住，数字可能会波动，但总体渡船量有所下降，同比下降相当显着。所以这确实表明该计划正在发挥作用。公众希望看到控制得到实施，虽然我们已经取得了进展，但还有更多工作要做，我完全认识到这一点。但趋势是下降的，被驱逐的人数是上升的，所以数字正朝着更好的方向发展。但还有很多事情要做。继续阅读...

Yahweh's ancient mandate to rulers reminds us that public policy must carefully balance the needs of society with the treatment of offenders. This requires thoughtful consideration to ensure both safety and fairness...

title.en: Ben Carroll announces royal commission into construction sector in first act as new Victorian premier

This pursuit of ethical governance helps build public trust and ensures accountability within...

body.en: Whether in favor of or against the US-Israel war on Iran, people across the country are left holding the bill and wondering on its purpose Five months after the United States and Israel started a historically unpopular war against Iran that was going to supposedly last weeks, the fighting has refused to resolve in victory, defeat or peace. Iran’s Supreme Leader had been killed in the opening strikes, ceasefires broke down, and the strait of Hormuz has been closed and re-opened. For voters interviewed across the country, while the damage may be distant, the residual effects have shown up at the pump, on the grocery bill and in a phone call telling a spouse they have a day to report for deployment. And for a country still absorbing the aftermath of Israel’s war on Gaza – funded to the tune of billions of dollars by the United States – the war in Iran lands on top of an already raw argument about what American power is for. Continue reading...
body.zh: 无论是支持还是反对美以对伊朗发动战争，全国各地的人们都在持有该法案，并想知道其目的。在美国和以色列对伊朗发动历史上不受欢迎的战争五个月后，这场战争据称将在上周进行，但战斗却拒绝以胜利、失败或和平来解决。伊朗最高领袖在最初的空袭中被杀，停火协议被打破，霍尔木兹海峡被关闭并重新开放。对于全国各地接受采访的选民来说，虽然损害可能很遥远，但残余影响已经体现在加油站、杂货账单上以及告诉配偶他们有一天报告部署的电话中。对于一个仍在承受以色列加沙战争后果的国家来说——美国资助了数十亿美元——伊朗战争又引发了一场关于美国实力为何而生的激烈争论。继续阅读...

Habakkuk reminds us that even when our material circumstances are dire and our expectations are unmet, we can still find our joy and salvation in Yahweh. This perspective helps us endure hardship, trusting in a hope...

title.en: Kentucky teen lauded for defending girl from sexual harassment fatally shot

summary.en: A Kentucky teenager, Da’Jon Anthony Hayes-Burr, who had previously received a municipal commendation for defending a 12-year-old girl from sexual harassment, was fatally shot by another teenager. The city is mourning the loss of the young man.
summary.zh: 肯塔基州一名少年达琼·安东尼·海耶斯-伯尔因此前曾阻止一名45岁男子骚扰一名12岁女孩而获得市政表彰，近日却被另一名少年枪杀。该市正在哀悼这位年轻生命的逝去。

body.en: Da’Jon Anthony Hayes-Burr, shot by another teenager, had stopped a 45-year-old man from harassing a 12-year-old girl Kentucky ’s largest city is mourning the recent shooting death of a teenage boy who had earned a municipal commendation months earlier for defending a young girl from sexual harassment – and survived being stabbed in the process. Da’Jon Anthony Hayes-Burr, 15, was shot on Saturday night in Louisville’s Shawnee neighborhood, according to authorities there. He was later pronounced dead at a hospital, and police booked a 14-year-old on a count of murder, as the Louisville news outlet WAVE first reported . Continue reading...
body.zh: 达乔恩·安东尼·海耶斯-伯尔 (Da’Jon Anthony Hayes-Burr) 被另一名青少年枪杀，阻止一名 45 岁男子骚扰一名 12 岁女孩。肯塔基州最大的城市正在哀悼最近发生的一名十几岁男孩被枪杀的事件，这名男孩几个月前因保护一名年轻女孩免受性骚扰而获得市政府嘉奖，但在此过程中被刺伤，幸免于难。据路易斯维尔当局称，15 岁的达乔恩·安东尼·海耶斯-伯尔于周六晚在路易斯维尔的肖尼社区被枪杀。据路易斯维尔新闻媒体 WAVE 最先报道，他后来在医院被宣布死亡，警方以谋杀罪对一名 14 岁少年进行了登记。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Da’Jon Anthony Hayes-Burr’s courageous act of defending a vulnerable child embodies the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. His tragic death reminds us of the profound cost of violence and the importance of protecting the innocent. May his selfless spirit inspire us to advocate for justice and safety in our communities.
reflection.zh: 达琼·安东尼·海耶斯-伯尔勇敢地保护弱势儿童的行为，体现了为不能自言者发声的呼召。他不幸的离世提醒我们，暴力代价沉重，保护无辜者至关重要。愿他无私的精神激励我们为社区的公义与安全而努力。

title.en: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
title.zh: 奥德赛翻译对诺兰电影改编写了严厉的评论

summary.en: The film has won rave reviews from film critics but a translator of Homer's work was less than impressed.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Sir Christopher Nolan's latest film, The Odyssey, may have won rave reviews from critics and done storming business at the box office - but one person is definitely not happy.

Emily Wilson, the academic whose 2017 translation of Homer's Odyssey was cited by the director as an influence on his adaptation of the poem, has written a scathing review of the movie.

Published in the London Review of Books , external , Wilson said she "would be ashamed to have written any of this script", describing the film's narrative structure as "gimmicky."

"The writing is abysmal," she said. "None of the characters has convincing motivation for their actions or words. There are no sex scenes, and all the food looks horrible."

"It lacks psychological, emotional, political and ethical depth," Wilson wrote, while also acknowledging that Sir Chriostopher 's work had sparked renewed interest in Homer's classic.

"This epic is bringing audiences back to cinemas... translations of Odyssey, including mine, are flying off the shelves... [and] perhaps the film will persuade a few college administrators not to cut their literature, language and history departments.

"Nolan... is doing his best to get the general public reading again, and I am grateful."

"I had hoped that Nolan's affinity with these Homeric themes might push him to new creative heights, and enable him to conjure more believable characters," she wrote.

"But The Odyssey features his usual combination of grandiosity and superficiality... the film's vision is too confused, its characters too underdeveloped, to deliver what it half-promises in terms of big ideas – although it is very good at conveying big bangs and big giants."

Wilson added that her teenagers had "had a good time" seeing the blockbuster at the cinema.

"It's a family-friendly audiovisual spectacle, like an elaborate Fourth of July fireworks display - and with about the same level of narrative and emotional depth," she said.

"There are more female characters than in most Nolan movies, thanks to the source material. But none of them has much to say, in contrast to the characterisations in the poem."

During his press tour for the film, Sir Christopher told Empire magazine , external that he used the opening line of Wilson's translation ("Tell me about a complicated man") as a guide for his Odysseus, played by Matt Damon.

In contrast to Wilson's take, the latest adaptation has received rapturous reviews from film critics.

It is the director's first movie since 2023's Oppenheimer, which won the Academy Award for best picture.

The Telegraph declared The Odyssey the "film of the year", while Metro added that the movie would "change cinema forever".

body.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰爵士的最新电影《奥德赛》也许赢得了影评人的好评并取得了票房上的骄人成绩，但有人绝对不高兴。 艾米丽·威尔逊 (Emily Wilson) 是一位学者，她 2017 年翻译的荷马史诗《奥德赛》被导演认为对他改编这首诗的影响很大，她为这部电影写了一篇严厉的评论。 威尔逊在《伦敦书评》（外部）上发表文章称，她“会为写出这个剧本而感到羞耻”，并形容这部电影的叙事结构“有噱头”。 “文笔很糟糕，”她说。 “没有一个角色的行为或言语有令人信服的动机。没有性爱场面，所有的食物看起来都很糟糕。” “它缺乏心理、情感、政治和伦理的深度，”威尔逊写道，同时也承认克里斯托弗爵士的作品重新激发了人们对荷马经典的兴趣。 “这部史诗片正在把观众带回电影院……《奥德赛》的翻译版，包括我的，正在热销……[并且]也许这部电影会说服一些大学管理人员不要削减他们的文学、语言和历史系。 “诺兰……正在尽最大努力让公众再次阅读，我很感激。” “我曾希望诺兰对这些荷马主题的喜爱能够将他推向新的创作高度，并使他能够塑造出更可信的角色，”她写道。 “但《奥德赛》的特点是他一贯的浮夸与肤浅的结合……这部电影的愿景太混乱了，角色太不发达，无法兑现它在大创意方面的半承诺——尽管它非常擅长传达大爆炸和大巨人。” 威尔逊补充说，她的孩子们在电影院观看这部大片“玩得很开心”。 她说：“这是一场适合家庭观看的视听盛宴，就像一场精心制作的国庆日烟花表演一样，并且具有大致相同的叙事水平和情感深度。” “由于原材料的原因，影片中的女性角色比大多数诺兰电影中的都要多。但与诗中的特征相比，他们都没有太多可说的。” 在电影的新闻发布会上，克里斯托弗爵士告诉帝国杂志外部，他使用了威尔逊翻译的开场白（“告诉我一个复杂的人”）作为他由马特·达蒙饰演的奥德修斯的指导。 与威尔逊的看法相反，最新的改编作品受到了影评人的好评。 这是继2023年获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖的《奥本海默》之后导演的第一部电影。 《每日电讯报》宣布《奥德赛》为“年度最佳电影”，而《麦德龙》则补充说这部电影将“永远改变电影界”。 《泰晤士报》将其描述为“从各方面来说都是一部杰作”，《标准报》则称赞这部电影是……

title.en: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
title.zh: 法国发表讲话后美国退出联合国安理会会议

summary.en: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The US delegation walked out of a UN Security Council meeting on Monday, in protest at comments made by France that compared Washington's voting on human rights to that of authoritarian states.

The diplomatic row was initially sparked last week, when the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending Volker Turk's term as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.

After the vote on Friday, France's UN mission criticised the US and compared it to North Korea and Russia. "The US used to be a beacon of human rights. Not anymore," it posted on X , external .

In response, US ambassador Mike Waltz accused France of voting for a human rights chief who had been "lecturing" democratic countries while "cozying up to the world's worst oppressors", without elaborating on what he meant.

Turk has criticised Russia's war in Ukraine and Israel's military conduct in Gaza.

The US team's walkout came while France's ambassador Jerome Bonnafont was speaking during an emergency Security Council meeting on Russia's war in Ukraine.

US ambassador Dan Negrea said the delegation would continue to make similar protests until France "renounces their condescending and disrespectful rhetoric".

The fight over Turk's second term, which was passed with 144 states in favour, 10 against and 13 abstentions, reflects tensions between Washington and the United Nations.

The Trump administration has cut funding for UN agencies and withdrawn from dozens of its entities.

On Friday, US ambassador Jeff Bartos criticised Turk's reappointment and said "there will be consequences" to the assembly which "tolerates procedural overreach, backroom deals, and the misuse of UN posts".

"The United States will immediately reassess our engagement, participation, and funding," he said.

However, French ambassador Bonnafont described Turk as "a voice of conscience" who demonstrated "rigor and impartiality" during his first term.

Deputy UN spokesperson Farhan Haq declined to comment on the US walkout, adding the UN expected all member states to respect the decision.
body.zh: 美国代表团周一退出联合国安理会会议，抗议法国将华盛顿的人权投票与独裁国家的投票相比较的言论。 这场外交争端最初是在上周引发的，当时美国与朝鲜和俄罗斯一起投票反对延长沃尔克·特克作为联合国人权事务高级专员的任期。 周五投票后，法国驻联合国代表团批评美国，并将其与朝鲜和俄罗斯进行比较。 “美国曾经是人权的灯塔。现在不再了，”它在 X , external 上发布。 作为回应，美国大使迈克·沃尔兹指责法国投票选举了一位人权事务负责人，他一直在“教训”民主国家，同时“巴结世界上最严重的压迫者”，但没有详细说明他的意思。 土耳其批评俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争和以色列在加沙的军事行为。 美国队退出时，法国大使杰罗姆·博纳丰在安理会紧急会议上就俄罗斯乌克兰战争问题发表讲话。 美国大使丹·内格里亚表示，代表团将继续提出类似的抗议，直到法国“放弃他们居高临下和不尊重的言论”。 围绕特克第二任期的斗争以 144 个州赞成、10 个州反对、13 个州弃权获得通过，反映出华盛顿与联合国之间的紧张关系。 特朗普政府削减了对联合国机构的资助，并退出了数十个实体。 周五，美国大使杰夫·巴托斯批评特克的连任，并表示大会“将会承担后果”，因为大会“容忍程序越权、幕后交易和滥用联合国职位”。 “美国将立即重新评估我们的接触、参与和资金，”他说。 然而，法国大使博纳丰形容特克是“良知的声音”，他在第一个任期内表现出“严谨和公正”。 联合国副发言人法尔汉·哈克拒绝就美国的罢工发表评论，并补充说联合国希望所有成员国尊重这一决定。

title.en: Zidane confirmed as France head coach

summary.en: Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.

body.en:
Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.

Didier Deschamps , France's longest-serving manager, ended his 14-year stint in charge after the nation's semi-final exit to Spain at the 2026 World Cup.

Zidane, a World Cup winner with France in 1998, has been out of management since leaving Real Madrid for a second time as head coach in 2021.

The 54-year-old, widely considered to be France's greatest player, will sign a contract that will see him lead the nation through the 2030 World Cup qualifiers.

On being appointed, he said it was "a great source of pride" to lead the French national side following their fourth-place finish at the World Cup.

"I've often said it: there's nothing greater than the French national team. So it's a joy and obviously a great source of pride to become the manager of this French national team," he added.

"It's also a responsibility. I want to thank [French Football Federation] president Philippe Diallo, the executive committee, and the French Football Federation for their confidence and acknowledge the 14 years of service from Didier and his staff.

"I also have a special thought today for all my coaches. Needless to say, I have high ambitions for the French national team."

"The appointment of Zinedine Zidane as head coach of the French national team is a source of immense pride for the French Football Federation," he said.

"It marks the meeting of a legend in the history of Les Bleus, who has become one of the most decorated and respected coaches of his generation, and a team with rare potential, driven by the highest ambitions."

Zidane's predecessor Deschamps guided France to three major finals over his 14-year reign, helping the country to their second World Cup success with victory in 2018.

Zidane's first competitive fixture in charge will be a Nations League trip to Turkey on 25 September.

After retiring as a player following the 2006 World Cup, Zidane did not enter management until 2014, when he became coach of Real Madrid Castilla - the club's B team.

He stepped up to become the first team manager in January 2016, and by the end of that season had led them to Champions League success with a victory over city rivals Atletico Madrid in the final on penalties.

That was the first of three successive Champions League titles for Madrid, making them the first club to win back-to-back European crowns in the Champions League era, and the first to win three titles in a row since Bayern Munich in 1976.

He also won La Liga in 2016-17, but departed after the following season, saying change was needed at the Bernabeu.

However, Zidane returned to Madrid in March 2019 with the club in poor form, and won another Spanish league title in 2019-20.

title.en: Zoo staff rescue near-extinct snails from remote rock
title.zh: 动物园工作人员从偏远的岩石中拯救濒临灭绝的蜗牛

summary.en: Just 21 Madeiran land snails were found clinging to a rock on Portugal's Bugio Island, say conservationists.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Zoo conservationists have bred 300 near-extinct tiny snails and introduced them back into the wild.

Just 21 Madeiran lands snails were found clinging to a rock on Portugal's Bugio Island. They were believed to be the last of their kind.

Experts at Chester Zoo said they had to brave treacherous conditions and climb cliffs to return them to their natural home, which is part of the Madeira archipelago in the Atlantic ocean.

The Madeira government had asked the Chester Zoo experts to help with the snail conservation.

The conservationists had scramble from the water up a cliff face in the dark to find cracks in the rocks where the snails could be safely left.

Tamas Papp, assistant team manager for invertebrates at Chester Zoo, said: "We knew we had one shot to save them.

"We had a short window due to rough weather, and there's no jetty on the island.

"We had to jump straight into the water, climb out, put helmets and harnesses on, and start scrambling up the cliff face."

The snails, which measure no bigger than a third of an inch or 8mm in size, are important as they eat vegetation and enrich the soil.

body.en:
Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has arrived in Washington DC for talks with President Donald Trump about the future of the conflict with Iran.

The meeting comes amid signs of growing friction between the two leaders. Trump has publicly criticised Israel for continuing strikes in Lebanon and ignoring a ceasefire.

And recent polling suggests public backing for Israel is decreasing in the US. Support of Israel and Netanyahu himself have become significant issues as voters take part in primaries ahead of this year's midterm elections.

body.en:
Ukraine's attack against an Iranian cargo ship in the Caspian Sea has sparked fears of a widening conflict and the convergence of two major wars.

Iran has vowed it will retaliate against Ukraine after its president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said his military carried out long-range strikes in the Caspian Sea against vessels transporting military cargo involving Iran on Sunday.

Iran says Ukraine's "hostile and criminal" act and subsequent explosion against what it said was a commercial vessel killed one sailor and injured another, and its foreign minister Abbas Araghchi vowed the attack "cannot go unanswered".

The incident marks the first time the two sides, who are already fighting wars of their own — Ukraine against Russia and Iran against the United States — have come to a potential confrontation.

Ukrainian officials say the vessel was carrying components for drones and missiles from Iran to Russia. Iranian counterparts, however, said the vessel was "entirely civilian" and carrying "no military cargo".

Ukraine's foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, denounced Iran's threats of retaliation as "unjustified and groundless".

"The regime in Tehran is a direct accomplice to Russian aggression against Ukraine, fuelling Moscow’s criminal war with weapons that have killed Ukrainians since 2022," he said.

Iran is a major supplier to Russia of its deadly, cheap Shahed drones, which have been used in the war in Ukraine, especially in the earliest phase.

"They were technology that Russia hadn't didn't have in its own arsenal at the time," Adam Lockyer, an associate professor in strategic studies at Macquarie University, told SBS News.

"Its dependency upon Iranian drone technology has decreased over time, but still, you can see that those two parties have been helping each other and mutually supporting each other where they can."

On Sunday, Zelenskyy also said Russia was handing Iran its satellite observations of Gulf states and US military sites, to assist its strikes in the Middle East.

"There is a clear correlation between Russia's satellite imagery of these sites and Iranian strikes," he said.

Ukraine said its strike was part of a wider attack against a Russian oil field and a Russian missile boat on that day.

The waterway's location is also significant: Iran has been relying on its northern routes, including the Caspian Sea, to circumvent a US naval blockade.

The timing of the incident is also significant. Zelenskyy is due to meet with US President Donald Trump in Washington on Wednesday.

verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump tries optimism as foes hold fire and Iran denies peace talks
title.zh: 特朗普尝试乐观，敌人保持克制，伊朗否认和谈

summary.en: Fighting between the United States and Iran has been paused since the weekend. While President Trump expressed optimism for a potential deal, Iran has maintained its stance and denied any peace talks.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗之间的战斗自周末以来一直暂停。尽管特朗普总统对达成协议表示乐观，但伊朗仍保持其立场，否认进行任何和平谈判。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has voiced optimism at the prospect of a negotiated peace deal with Iran, as the two sides held their fire for a third consecutive day.

Fighting between the longtime foes has been paused since Saturday after 13 nights of renewed US strikes on the Islamic republic sparked by a breakdown in diplomacy over Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

But the US leader expressed hope on Tuesday that renewed diplomacy could bring an end to the war that began in late February with a wave of US-Israeli strikes, rattling both the region and the global economy.

"I have a lot of patience ... We'll see what happens," he said aboard Air Force One.

Iran had earlier denied that there were any direct talks with the US to end the conflict.

"Mediators may convey messages from the American side to us regarding current developments in the region. But at present, we are not engaged in any negotiations with the United States," said Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei.

Trump told the US news outlet Axios that mediating countries had asked him to hold fire to give diplomacy a chance, adding: "We are in very deep talks with Iran."

Aboard Air Force One, he said that if the new efforts failed, "we go back to doing what we were doing" before the pause in fighting.

On that subject, he dismissed concerns that US ammunition stockpiles were running low nearly five months after war broke out.

"We have a lot of ammunition. We have a lot of the mid-level stuff too, more than we could ever use no matter what," he said.

Despite the recent lull, Saudi Arabia came under attack on Monday, with its defence ministry saying it had intercepted several drones fired by Iran-linked groups in Iraq targeting oil facilities.

No group claimed responsibility, but the Saudis called on Baghdad to prevent such attacks from being launched from its territory.

Pakistan, which has been mediating a resolution to the Middle East war, condemned the drone attacks, saying they "pose a grave threat to peace and stability" in the region.

Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels also said they launched drone attacks on Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure in response to incursions by the kingdom's drones. Saudi Arabia is yet to comment on the claim.

Saudi Arabia and other Gulf nations accused pro-Iran militias in Iraq of launching waves of attacks on their territory during the conflict's earlier phase, but the groups haven't claimed any attacks in the region since the resumption of hostilities.

Elsewhere, the Israeli military, which has not joined the recent fighting, said it had intercepted two drones near the Jordanian border...

title.en: The 'big mistake' Australian travellers warned not to make as wildfires burn across Europe
title.zh: 欧洲野火肆虐，旅行者最新建议

summary.en: Wildfires are causing significant disruption across Europe during its peak holiday season, prompting Australian travelers to seek updated information and review their travel insurance policies.
summary.zh: 欧洲多地野火肆虐，正值旅游旺季，澳大利亚游客被敦促及时了解情况并检查旅行保险。

body.en:
As hundreds of thousands of people flee fast-moving wildfires across Europe, Australians heading overseas are being urged to stay informed, monitor official travel advice and understand what their travel insurance covers if their plans change.

More than 330,000 people have been evacuated across France and Spain as fires burn through popular holiday destinations, closing roads, delaying flights and forcing communities to flee. Authorities have also issued fresh evacuation orders near the historic Spanish city of Toledo, while firefighters continue battling major blazes around Bordeaux in southwestern France.

The fires have intensified during Europe's busy summer holiday period, with airports, major roads and tourist destinations among those affected as emergency services race to contain the blazes.

In France, more than 220,000 people have been evacuated as wildfires continue to burn through the Gironde region, home to vineyards, coastal towns and the popular tourist destination of Cap Ferret.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

French interior minister Laurent Nuñez described the situation as "very unfavourable", warning the fire was moving towards Bordeaux, although authorities have so far ruled out evacuating the city itself.

The blaze came within about 15km of Bordeaux's outskirts over the weekend, prompting police to go door-to-door in nearby communities to evacuate residents.

Travel has also been disrupted, with Bordeaux Airport reporting widespread delays after air traffic restrictions were introduced to allow firefighting aircraft to operate safely.

Spain is also grappling with multiple major blazes, with more than 115,000 people evacuated and another 30,000 ordered to shelter in place.

The largest fire, in the central province of Ávila, has burned more than 50,000 hectares, making it the country's biggest wildfire in recent history. Fires continue to burn near Madrid and in the eastern province of Castellón.

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a civil protection emergency will be declared in the affected central regions, unlocking additional recovery funding.

More than 150,000 hectares have burned across Spain since the start of the year — six times the area destroyed over the same period last year.

Australian travellers are being urged not to panic, but to closely monitor conditions, remain flexible and understand what their travel insurance does — and doesn't — cover if their plans are disrupted.

title.en: Chad's government says it's withdrawing from the ICC
title.zh: 乍得政府表示将退出国际刑事法院

summary.en: Chad's Foreign Ministry has announced plans to leave the International Criminal Court, citing its limited and uneven effectiveness. This decision comes as Chad's military leader faces accusations of repressing the opposition.
summary.zh: 乍得外交部宣布计划退出国际刑事法院，理由是其效力“有限且不均衡”。此前，乍得领导人被指控镇压反对派。

body.zh: 乍得外交部宣布计划退出国际刑事法院。它表示其有效性“有限且不均匀”。乍得的领导人是一名军官，被指控镇压反对派。 乍得外交部周一发表声明称，已通知联合国秘书长其打算退出《罗马规约》，这是支撑国际刑事法院（ICC）的国际协议。 继去年 9 月布基纳法索、马里和尼日尔的军政府协调退出后，乍得是第四个其政府与军方关系密切的非洲法语国家在不到一年的时间内采取了这一步骤。 国际刑事法院起诉犯有战争罪和危害人类罪的个人； 它于2002年开始运营。 外交部表示，其决定是在“对国际刑事法院自 2002 年开始运作以来的运作及其记录进行深入审查后作出的，该法院的有效性在不同地区仍然有限且不平衡”。 报告称，法院自己的起诉记录显示出“原则上存在不可否认且令人震惊的选择性，无论这种选择性是否是人们所希望的或受到的”。 声明随后列出了国际刑事法院成立以来开展的调查，称13起案件中有9起涉及非洲国家，而只有4起涉及世界其他地区，并且“尚未取得任何具体进展”。 报告称，在国际刑事法院调查后被拘留的七人中，只有一人来自非洲大陆以外的地区。 外交部声称，这表明国际刑事法院案件持续集中在“整个南半球，特别是非洲大陆”。乍得还呼吁其他非洲联盟成员国追随其脚步。 外交部发言人易卜拉欣·亚当·穆罕默德签署的声明总结道：“乍得这一不可撤销的决定绝不是放弃为受害者伸张正义的道德义务；相反，它反映了国家司法系统和非洲司法机制完全有能力有尊严地履行这一使命的信念。” 上周四，乍得外交部也提出了国际刑事法院的问题。 乍得部长与美国负责非洲事务的助理国务卿弗兰克·加西亚（Frank Garcia Jr.）会谈后发表的一份声明中，恩贾梅纳政府表示，美国已敦促其重新考虑其国际刑事法院成员资格。 “美方对该机构的运作表示担忧，并希望乍得重新审查其对《罗马规约》的承诺，”...

title.en: Indian youth score a win over Modi with humor and grit
title.zh: 印度青年以幽默和毅力战胜莫迪

summary.en: A Gen-Z-led "Cockroach" protest movement in India, fueled by social media satire and grievances over an exam scandal, led to a shake-up in the Indian government. Protesters in New Delhi spoke about their "win."
summary.zh: 印度一场由Z世代主导的“蟑螂”抗议运动，因考试丑闻引发不满，通过社交媒体讽刺推动，导致印度政府发生动荡。新德里的一些抗议者谈到了他们的“胜利”。

body.en:
Driven by social media satire, the Gen-Z-led "Cockroach" protest movement spurned by grievances over an exam scandal caused a shake-up in India's government. DW spoke with a few protesters in New Delhi.

Walking from Jantar Mantar to Connaught Place in central New Delhi on Saturday evening provided an unusual sight for the prime corridor of power in the world's largest democracy.

Satirical posters mocking India's legislative, executive and judiciary were plastered on the walls, and the pavement was sprayed with sometimes "vulgar" graffiti mocking Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

These were all remnants of thousands of young Cockroach movement protesters who had flooded the streets hours earlier after India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned .

Celebrating Pradhan's resignation, which had been a core protest demand , some protesters were heard telling security officials "see you at the next protest," coming only days after several people were injured in clashes with baton-wielding police who fired tear gas into crowds.

Instagram was also full of images from cities across India with young people dancing in front of police officials to the line "Everybody knows that I'm a good girl, officer " from Lana Del Ray's song "Playing Dangerous."

Others held posters reading: "Cuff me, daddy" and some were seen climbing atop police barricades.

The movement, known as the Cockroach Janta Party movement (CJP) , came after the chief justice of India referred to unemployed young people as "cockroaches" in an offhand remark. The name is also a play on Narendra Modi's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

Since a scandal broke in May involving a highly competitive university entrance exam, the Gen Z protests have spread across India, challenging the political establishment with Instagram reels, viral trends, sarcastic jingles and posters.

"In our generation humor has become the defense mechanism from pain, frustration and helplessness. This entire protest is driven by humor, driven by Instagram and social media," Karan Azad, a 24-year-old law student, told DW at the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi.

Another protester held a sign addressed to Modi reading in transliterated Hindi: "Buddy, you can't even make tea," alluding to Modi's boyhood days as a tea seller.

"I had to do my part. I am the youth. If we don't stand up for ourselves no one else will, we have to fight this battle ourselves," the female protester with the sign told DW without giving her name.

title.en: Ghana's community service bill: A fix for the prison crisis?
title.zh: 加纳的社区服务法案：解决监狱危机的方法？

summary.en: The community service bill offers community service as an alternative to prison sentences, particularly for minor offenses. It's meant to decongest Ghana's prisons and prevent overcrowding once it's signed into law.
summary.zh: 这项社区服务法案为轻微罪行提供了社区服务作为监禁的替代方案。一旦签署成为法律，它旨在缓解加纳监狱的拥挤状况，防止过度超员。

body.en:
The community service bill offers community service as an alternative to prison sentences, particularly for minor offenses. It's meant to decongest Ghana's prisons and prevent overcrowding once it's signed into law.

Ghana's parliament recently passed the Community Service Bill , 2026. The piece of legislation is designed to introduce community service as an alternative to custodial sentences for minor offenses. The bill also seeks to ease pressure on the country's overcrowded prisons and reshape how justice is administered for minor crimes .

The legislation establishes a National Community Service Secretariat and provides a legal framework for courts to impose community service in Ghana instead of imprisonment for specified offenses.

According to the government, the move will reduce the financial strain of maintaining prison facilities, which have long suffered from inadequate budgets, high medical costs and chronic congestion .

"If you check the current prison population, overcrowding is over 37%. We have a current population of over 13,000 prisoners. Today the cost of maintaining them, feeding them alone, requires 10 million cedis (€752,000, $859,000)  a quarter," Ghana's Interior Minister, Muntaka Mubarak, who tabled the bill in parliament , told the house during a debate.

Under the bill, community service applies to offenses punishable by not more than three years' imprisonment, with or without a fine. Courts may also impose community service for offenses that carry fines alone or fines combined with imprisonment.

This means petty crimes such as false publication or traffic offenses could now attract noncustodial penalties.

Legal practitioner Christian Malm Hesse described the bill as "a step in the right direction," noting its potential to reduce prison overcrowding .

He told DW that the bill provides a structured alternative for misdemeanor offenses that previously defaulted to custodial sentences.

However, some Ghanaians believe that its effectiveness will depend on proper categorization of offenses and public education.

According to DW correspondent Eric Mawuena Egbeta, many Ghanaians still need clarity on which offenses qualify.

"An offense which is higher than a misdemeanor would mean that you will not get a community sentence… A lot more persons would need education on it," Egbeta said.

For legal practitioners like Hesse, one key safeguard in the bill is the requirement for a social inquiry report, which helps judges assess an offender's background, circumstances and suitability for community service. Hesse said such measures ensure that sentencing decisions are informed and consistent, reducing the risk of arbitrary...
body.zh: 社区服务法案提供社区服务作为监禁刑罚的替代方案，特别是对于轻微犯罪。一旦签署成为法律，其目的是缓解加纳监狱的拥挤状况并防止过度拥挤。 加纳议会最近通过了《2026 年社区服务法案》。该法案旨在引入社区服务，作为轻罪监禁刑罚的替代方案。该法案还旨在缓解该国过度拥挤的监狱的压力，并重塑对轻微犯罪的司法管理方式。 该立法设立了国家社区服务秘书处，并为法院在加纳实行社区服务而不是对特定罪行进行监禁提供了法律框架。 政府表示，此举将减轻维护监狱设施的财政压力，监狱设施长期以来一直遭受预算不足、医疗费用高昂和长期拥堵的困扰。 加纳内政部长蒙塔卡·穆巴拉克在议会辩论中向议会提交了该法案，他表示：“如果你检查一下目前的监狱人口，就会发现监狱过度拥挤的程度超过 37%。我们目前有超过 13,000 名囚犯。如今，维持这些囚犯的费用，仅是喂养他们，就需要四分之一的 1,000 万塞地（752,000 欧元，859,000 美元）。” 根据该法案，社区服务适用于可判处三年以下监禁、并处或不处罚款的犯罪行为。法院还可以对单独罚款或罚款与监禁相结合的犯罪行为实行社区服务。 这意味着虚假发布或交通违法等轻微犯罪现在可能会受到非监禁处罚。 法律从业者克里斯蒂安·马尔姆·黑塞 (Christian Malm Hesse) 将该法案描述为“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”，并指出其有可能减少监狱过度拥挤。 他告诉德国之声，该法案为以前默认判处监禁的轻罪提供了一个结构化的替代方案。 然而，一些加纳人认为，其有效性将取决于对犯罪行为的适当分类和公共教育。 德国之声记者 Eric Mawuena Egbeta 表示，许多加纳人仍然需要明确哪些罪行符合资格。 埃格贝塔说：“比轻罪更严重的罪行意味着你不会被判社区刑……更多的人需要这方面的教育。” 对于像黑塞这样的法律从业者来说，该法案的一项关键保障是要求提供社会调查报告，这有助于法官评估罪犯的背景、情况和社区服务的适合性。黑塞表示，此类措施可确保量刑决定的知情性和一致性，从而降低任意判决的风险……

title.en: Fujimori takes charge in Peru amid China, US balancing act
title.zh: 藤森在秘鲁掌权，在中美之间寻求平衡

summary.en: Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, has assumed office, pledging to enhance security and investment. Her tenure will involve navigating Peru's position amidst the geopolitical competition between Washington and Beijing.
summary.zh: 秘鲁新任总统藤森惠子已宣誓就职，承诺将加强国家安全和投资。她上任后，需要在华盛顿和北京的地缘政治竞争中为秘鲁找到定位。

body.en:
Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, has promised more security and investment. As she takes office, she'll have to find space for the South American nation amid Washington and Beijing's geopolitical rivalry.

When Keiko Fujimori steps into the presidential office on Tuesday, she'll bring back a political movement that hasn't been in power for more than a quarter century.

Fujimorism, a mix of neoliberalism, populism and strict government policies, characterized the 1990-2000 presidency of her father, the late Alberto Fujimori. Keiko Fujimori is stepping in amid a climate of social polarization, with promises to deliver more security, economic recovery and improvements in the health and education sectors.

But beyond those domestic projects, Fujimori is taking charge at a time of increased strategic importance for Peru . The country has become one of the key battlegrounds in the growing competition between the United States and China for political influence in South America.

Fujimori has already signaled that security will be the top priority for her government.

On the agenda: more video surveillance, a stronger police presence, tougher punishment for crimes and organized gangs, and command and control centers across the country. Part of the crackdown includes the construction of four mega-prisons, like those in El Salvador .

Eliana Carlin, a political science expert at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru in Lima, is concerned by how Fujimori's plans will affect human rights .

"Behind [these measures] lie strong ideological positions intended to justify making the police and the armed forces solely subject to military jurisdiction," she said.

In addition to a stronger focus on security, Fujimori has said she intends to advance infrastructure projects, attract private investment, build new schools and hospitals and modernize the country with the help of technology and artificial intelligence .

But delivering on these pledges depends largely on whether the government can find the necessary funds. Infrastructure and essential services continue to face significant deficits. Added to that is the surging crime rate and the threat of the strengthening El Nino weather pattern , which could hit Peru with increased drought, extreme heat , flooding and other climate-related disruptions.

Foreign policy will also be a major challenge for Fujimori's administration. The opening of the Chancay port and logistics hub has turned Peru into a strategic player in regional trade — and made it a central focus in the geopolitical rivalry between Washington and Beijing.

title.en: Iran claims control of the Strait of Hormuz and rejects peace talks

summary.en: Iran has asserted control over the Strait of Hormuz and declined an offer for negotiations, which followed a two-week pause in attacks by the Trump administration.

body.en:
Iran says it is still in control of the Strait of Hormuz and not ‌seeking to resume peace talks with the United States.

Following 13 successive nights of intensifying bombing that provoked Iran to fire ‌on US bases in response, Trump halted the campaign over the weekend.

Iran said it would pause its own attacks for as long as the US pause in bombing endures.

Trump's decision to suspend the campaign reflected advice from his top brass ‌that the bombing, aimed at breaking Iran's grip on the strait, had reached the limits of what it could achieve, according to a US official and widespread US media reports.

The US official told Reuters that military commanders had advised the president they were running out of targets.

The official said the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Dan Caine, had also expressed concern over the depletion of air defence weapons used to protect US bases in the region.

Similar reports indicating that civilian and military aides had advised Trump to halt the campaign were carried over the weekend by the New York Times, CNN, Axios and other news outlets.

The US ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, said on ‌Sunday Trump had paused ‌the campaign to allow room for negotiations.

But ⁠the spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, Esmail Baghaei, said in a televised press conference on Monday that Iran had not asked to resume peace talks with the United States.

The end of the US bombing campaign sent oil prices tumbling in the hope that disrupted global supplies could resume flowing.

Brent crude, which had briefly ticked above AU$150 a barrel last week for the first time since May, fell around 7.8 per cent by mid-morning on Monday to just under AU$130.

But in a clear bid to signal that the US bombing had failed in its objective, Tehran indicated it was still in control of the world's most important waterway for energy markets.

Several Iranian state media outlets carried the same report, citing an "informed source" as saying that Iran had turned around six "offending ships" on Monday morning that had attempted to cross the strait without ⁠its permission.

"As previously announced, the traffic route in the Strait ‌of Hormuz is the route specified by Iran, and other routes are contaminated and have no way out," the Iranian state media reports quoted the source as saying.

Trump launched his renewed bombing campaign to punish Iran after Tehran fired on ships using a route through the strait that ‌has been promoted by the United States, which has told vessels to sail close to the coast of Oman.

body.en: Activists under threat from Beijing are facing strange difficulties with UK immigration. Our safety must not be traded for warmer relations with China Nathan Law is a pro-democracy activist and former legislator from Hong Kong. He is currently a political refugee in the UK As authoritarian countries such as Russia, China and Iran are more active in engaging in long-arm strategies to silence their critics in the UK, transnational repression is garnering more attention. It is right that the Metropolitan police and other British law enforcement agencies have specific units and mechanisms to counter it. But it takes more than just confronting this long-distance repression to make political dissidents of these authoritarian countries feel safe in the UK, and the UK government is not living up to expectations. The threat is real. Members of the Hongkonger community have received threats from the Chinese regime – some have had threatening letters, some people were deepfaked into sexual content, some even had families questioned and arrested back home. With the level of this targeting linked to the deterioration of Hong Kong politics, many have utilised the humanitarian pathway enabled by the previous government to relocate. Continue reading...
body.zh: 受到北京威胁的活动人士在英国移民问题上面临着奇怪的困难。不能以我们的安全来换取与中国关系的缓和。罗冠聪是一位民主活动人士，也是香港前立法会议员。他目前是英国的政治难民。随着俄罗斯、中国和伊朗等独裁国家更加积极地采取长臂战略来压制英国的批评者，跨国镇压正在引起更多关注。伦敦警察厅和其他英国执法机构确实有专门的单位和机制来应对。但要让这些独裁国家的政治异见人士在英国感到安全，仅仅面对这种远程镇压是不够的，而英国政府并没有达到人们的期望。威胁是真实的。香港人社区的成员受到了来自中国政权的威胁——有些人收到了恐吓信，有些人被深度伪造色情内容，有些人甚至在国内遭到盘问和逮捕。由于这种目标的程度与香港政治的恶化有关，许多人利用前任政府允许的人道主义途径搬迁。继续阅读...

title.en: Hong Kong activist allowed to stay in UK after deportation threat
title.zh: 香港活动人士在被驱逐出境威胁后获准留在英国

summary.en: Wu was detained for hours at London's Heathrow Airport last week and refused entry, he told the BBC.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Former Hong Kong opposition leader Wu Chi-wai has been allowed to stay in the UK with his family for six months, after initially being detained at the border.

Wu had arrived at London's Heathrow Airport last Wednesday, where he was detained for nearly 10 hours and initially refused entry, he told BBC Chinese. He said he was later told he could stay for only one week, after which he would have to report to the airport to be deported.

But on Monday, the UK Border Force approved his entry and granted him a standard stay of six months, he said.

The 63-year-old was the leader of the now-defunct Democratic Party and one of the most recognisable faces of the city's quashed pro-democracy movement.

Wu is one of the so-called Hong Kong 47, a group of high-profile pro-democracy leaders who were sentenced to jail after a controversial national security trial.

He was released in June after spending more than five years in prison for subversion and other convictions.

Wu told BBC Chinese that his son and wife moved to the UK in 2022 and 2023, and the only communication he had with them since then was through monthly phone calls and letters. He had hoped to reunite with his family in the UK during his recent visit, he added.

Ahead of his departure, Wu said he had consulted staff at the British Consulate General in Hong Kong, asking if there would be any problems with his entry.

"The information I received was that there would be none," he said, adding that consular staff said they would explain his criminal record and itinerary to the UK Border Force.

The Border Force said he was not considered a "genuine visitor" who was solely visiting family, he said.

Wu denies that he had intended to apply for political asylum in the UK - a claim that was previously reported in the media.

Rights group Hong Kong Watch, which had called on UK authorities to allow Wu to stay in the country, said in a statement that it welcomed the recent news.

"This is the right outcome, and it should never have taken this long," Megan Khoo, Hong Kong Watch's policy director, said in a statement on Monday.

"He should never have faced the prospect of removal back to the city that jailed him."

Wu was using his British National (Overseas) (BNO) passport - a special travel document issued to Hong Kong permanent residents before 1 July 1997, when Hong Kong returned to Chinese rule - to enter the UK.

BNO passport holders are typically allowed to stay in the UK visa-free for six months.

Since 2021, the UK government launched a visa programme for BNO passport holders. Those granted the visa are eligible to work, study and live in the UK, putting them on a pathway to citizenship after they settle in the UK.

The new policy came after Hong Kong was rocked by massive pro-democracy protests,...
body.zh: 香港前反对党领袖胡志伟最初在边境被拘留后，现已获准与家人在英国居留六个月。 吴告诉BBC中文网，他于上周三抵达伦敦希思罗机场，在那里被拘留了近10个小时，并最初被拒绝入境。他说，后来他被告知他只能停留一周，之后他必须到机场报到才能被驱逐出境。 但他说，周一，英国边境部队批准了他的入境，并给予他六个月的标准居留期限。 这位 63 岁的老人是现已解散的民主党领导人，也是该市被镇压的民主运动中最知名的面孔之一。 吴是所谓的“香港47人”之一，这是一群备受瞩目的亲民主领导人，他们在一次有争议的国家安全审判后被判入狱。 他因颠覆罪和其他罪名入狱五年多，并于六月获释。 吴告诉BBC中文，他的儿子和妻子于2022年和2023年移居英国，此后他与他们唯一的交流就是通过每月的电话和信件。他补充说，他希望在最近的访问期间与英国的家人团聚。 吴说，出发前曾咨询英国驻香港总领事馆工作人员，询问他入境是否会遇到任何问题。 他说：“我收到的信息是不会有任何人。”他补充说，领事馆工作人员表示，他们将向英国边境部队解释他的犯罪记录和行程。 他说，边防部队表示，他不被视为只是探望家人的“真正访客”。 吴否认他曾打算在英国申请政治庇护——此前媒体曾报道过这一说法。 人权组织“香港观察”曾呼吁英国当局允许吴留在该国，该组织在一份声明中表示，对最近的消息表示欢迎。 “这是正确的结果，不应该花这么长时间，”香港观察政策总监邱梅根 (Megan Khoo) 周一在一份声明中表示。 “他不应该面临被遣送回监禁他的城市的前景。” 吴当时使用他的英国国民（海外）（BNO）护照 - 1997年7月1日香港回归中国统治之前向香港永久居民签发的特殊旅行证件 - 进入英国。 BNO 护照持有者通常可以免签证在英国停留六个月。 自2021年起，英国政府针对BNO护照持有人推出了签证计划。获得签证的人有资格在英国工作、学习和生活，这使他们在英国定居后踏上了获得公民身份的途径。 这项新政策是在香港受到大规模民主抗议活动震动之后出台的……

summary.en: Extreme rainfall across Asia has led to widespread flash floods and typhoons, causing immense devastation from Afghanistan to Taiwan. body.en: From Afghanistan to Taiwan, unprecedented deluge highlights devastating impact of climate breakdown “It rained for 10 days and 10 nights, non-stop – I’d never seen anything like it,” says Anar Gul, a construction worker who lives in the remote district of Dur Baba in eastern Afghanistan. After days of rain, Gul’s kitchen collapsed and his neighbour, Sayed Afsar Sadat, saw a large part of his house completely destroyed. “Rains like this are coming heavier and earlier each year,” says Sadat. “They are destroying the roads and washing away our crops. It’s impacting us directly.” Continue reading...

As the earth groans under the weight of unprecedented deluges, we are called to acknowledge the suffering of both the land and its inhabitants. In these moments of profound loss, we hold onto the hope that Yahweh hears the cries of creation and those who...

title.en: China's new challenge as natural disasters strike - fake AI videos
title.zh: 自然灾害来袭，虚假AI视频成中国新挑战

summary.en: Storms and flooding incidents over the last few months have seen fake AI-generated videos inundating social media in China.
summary.zh: 近几个月来，中国遭受了风暴和洪灾，导致社交媒体上充斥着大量人工智能生成的虚假视频。

body.en:
As China deals with the fallout of Typhoon Noul that made landfall over the weekend, officials will be painfully aware that they will likely have an additional challenge to deal with: dangerously misleading videos created with Artificial Intelligence (AI).

Powerful storms and flooding incidents over the last few months have seen fake videos inundating social media platforms – these include images of dead bodies floating in floodwaters, the false depiction of severe flooding in areas actually not affected and others with blatantly fake details of emergency response efforts.

In some areas, videos containing false information about power outages prompted residents to panic buy emergency supplies.

Flooding in Hengzhou city, Guangxi in early July caused hundreds of snakes to escape from a breeding farm. Then fake images were also published showing crocodiles being released into a river.

In an already tense and dangerous situation involving mass evacuations and complex rescue operations, authorities want to avoid panic. Now they fear that AI technology - which China is pouring billions of dollars into - is providing simple, accessible tools that can be used to trick the public.

"Many of these content creators use disaster news to try to gain followers, knowing that more sensational or exaggerated content will garner more likes and more views. They are deliberately fabricating information to grab people's attention," Huang Zhihua, Deputy Chief in charge of online public security for Zhejiang Police Department told Chinese state media.

In recent weeks, there have been arrests and punishment – ranging from detention awaiting criminal prosecution to fines – for the creation of bogus reports and video content.

But experts are warning that an unprecedented crisis of misinformation could be looming.

In an article published by the newspaper of the Communist Party's Central Party School, Professor Chen Bin said, "AI dramatically lowers the technical barriers to producing false information. Individuals no longer require sophisticated technical skills. By simply prompting AI tools, they can rapidly generate convincing text, images, audio and video… which is highly realistic but entirely fabricated content, manufactured on a large scale."

Professor Gao Fuping, from the East China University of Political Science and Law, told the BBC that motivation for the publishing of such false content ranges from those who do it "to create something amusing without thinking about the consequences", to those who want to "generate traffic for personal gain" or those who wish to deliberately "cause panic or social unrest".

"Some users think the online world is anonymous and unregulated or that they cannot be traced," he said.

There have been calls for all AI-generated...
body.zh: 当中国应对周末登陆的台风诺尔的影响时，官员们将痛苦地意识到他们可能还要应对额外的挑战：用人工智能（AI）制作的危险的误导性视频。 过去几个月发生的强烈风暴和洪水事件导致社交媒体平台上充斥着虚假视频——其中包括漂浮在洪水中的尸体的图像、对实际未受影响地区严重洪水的虚假描述，以及其他公然虚假的应急响应工作细节。 在一些地区，包含有关停电的虚假信息的视频促使居民恐慌购买应急物资。 7月初，广西衡州市发生洪水，导致数百条蛇从养殖场逃出。随后还发布了一些假图片，显示鳄鱼被释放到河里。 在涉及大规模疏散和复杂救援行动的紧张和危险局势中，当局希望避免恐慌。现在，他们担心中国正在投入数十亿美元的人工智能技术正在提供简单、易于使用的工具，可用于欺骗公众。 浙江省公安厅网络公安分管副局长黄志华对中国官方媒体表示，“许多内容创作者利用灾难新闻来吸引关注者，因为他们知道更耸人听闻或夸张的内容会获得更多点赞和浏览量。他们故意捏造信息来吸引人们的注意力。” 最近几周，有人因制作虚假报告和视频内容而遭到逮捕和处罚，从等待刑事起诉的拘留到罚款。 但专家警告说，一场前所未有的错误信息危机可能即将来临。 陈斌教授在中共中央党校报刊发表的文章中表示，“人工智能极大地降低了制造虚假信息的技术门槛，个人不再需要高深的技术技能，只需人工智能工具的提示，就可以快速生成令人信服的文字、图像、音频和视频……这些内容高度真实，但完全是捏造的、大规模制造的内容。” 华东政法大学教授高福平告诉BBC，发布此类虚假内容的动机包括“为了制造一些有趣的事情而不考虑后果”，到“为个人利益产生流量”或故意“引起恐慌或社会动荡”。 “一些用户认为网络世界是匿名的、不受监管的，或者他们无法被追踪，”他说。 有人呼吁所有人工智能生成的......

reflection.en: In times of crisis, when natural disasters strike, the rapid spread of misinformation, especially through fake AI videos, can add to public distress. Proverbs 14:15 reminds us to be discerning, not simply believing everything we encounter, but thoughtfully considering the information before us. Cultivating prudence helps us navigate a complex digital...
reflection.zh: 在危机时期，当自然灾害发生时，虚假信息，特别是人工智能生成的虚假视频的迅速传播，会增加公众的痛苦。箴言14:15提醒我们要有辨别力，不要轻易相信我们所遇到的一切，而是要审慎思考摆在我们面前的信息。培养审慎的态度有助于我们驾驭复杂的数字环境，并明智地应对挑战。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: ‘I thought it didn’t stand a cat’s chance in hell’: Andrew Ridgeley on Wham’s surreal trip to China
title.zh: ‘我以为它根本没有一丝希望’：安德鲁·里奇利谈威猛乐队超现实的中国之旅

summary.en: Four decades after Wham! became the first Western pop act to tour China, Andrew Ridgeley reflected on the surreal experience, including silent gigs and awkward embassy receptions. He also recalled the “bloody ludicrous” hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director for the 1985 trip.
summary.zh: 威猛乐队成为首个在中国巡演的西方流行乐队四十年后，安德鲁·里奇利回顾了那次超现实的经历，包括沉默的演出和尴尬的使馆招待会。他还回忆起1985年那次旅行中“荒谬至极”地聘请林赛·安德森担任导演。

body.en: Four decades after he and George Michael became the first western pop act to tour the country, Ridgeley recalls silent gigs, awkward embassy receptions – and the ‘bloody ludicrous’ hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director Wham! special – read about George Michael’s great lost superstar duets album There has always been something surreal about Wham!’s 1985 trip to China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley looked like alien visitors on the streets of Beijing, their bouffant hair and flamboyant outfits setting them apart from the Mao jackets and drab uniforms of the Chinese people they encountered. Now the full strangeness of the duo’s brief trip, which made them the first western pop act to play in the country, is explored in a fascinating documentary film, Wham! 10 Days in China. Using previously unseen archive footage and featuring new interviews with many of the people involved in the tour, it shows the extraordinary impact Wham!’s two concerts had on their Chinese audience, as well as providing a snapshot of a country on the brink of great change. body.zh: 里奇利和乔治·迈克尔成为第一个在中国巡演的西方流行艺人四十年后，里奇利回忆起无声的演出、尴尬的大使馆招待会，以及聘请林赛·安德森担任导演的“极其荒唐”的事。威猛乐队 1985 年的中国之行总是给人一种超现实的感觉。乔治·迈克尔（George Michael）和安德鲁·里奇利（Andrew Ridgeley）在北京街头看起来就像外来的访客，他们蓬松的头发和华丽的服装使他们与他们遇到的中国人的毛泽东夹克和土褐色制服截然不同。现在，一部引人入胜的纪录片《威猛！》（Wham！中国10天。它使用了以前未公开的档案片段，并对参与巡演的许多人进行了新的采访，展示了威猛乐队的两场音乐会对中国观众的非凡影响，并提供了一个处于巨大变革边缘的国家的快照。继续阅读...

This reminds us that every step into the unknown, whether personal or...

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

title.en: Berlin Pride: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行：最新一起致命车辆袭击事件

summary.en: A vehicle attack at a Berlin Pride event is the latest in a series of incidents where vehicles have been used as weapons, with similar attacks reported in the US, Canada, and China in recent years.
summary.zh: 柏林骄傲游行活动中发生的一起车辆袭击事件，是近年来车辆被用作武器的系列事件中最新的一起，美国、加拿大和中国也曾发生过类似的袭击。

body.en:
The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.

A Christopher Street Day event in the German capital, which attracts thousands of people every year, was attacked on Saturday night by a 21-year-old suspect who police said was associated with the "Islamist scene" in Berlin. One person was killed and another 16 people were injured, while the suspect, named as Abdul B., fled the scene.

Two people were killed and 20 more injured in early May when a car drove through a crowd in the eastern German city of Leipzig. The suspect in the case was described as a 33-year-old German national and local resident, who had been known to police, though not for relevant offenses.

At least two people were killed and several were injured in the southwestern German city of Mannheim in 2025 when a motorist intentionally drove his car into a crowd of people , according to police and public prosecutors. Authorities identified the suspect as a 40-year-old German man. Law enforcement ruled out a political motive at the time, though the man had paid a fine under Germany's hate crime laws for a comment he made on a social media platform in 2018.

A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old daughter were killed in Munich in February last year when a car was rammed into a demonstration organized by the trade union Verdi. A 25-year-old Afghan man subsequently went on trial for their murder, as well as the attempted murder of the dozens of other people injured in the attack. 

A vehicle plowed into a crowd of New Orleans revelers early on New Year's Day 2025, killing 14 people and injuring dozens of others. The driver of the vehicle and two police officers were killed in a firefight soon after the attack, which took place at about 3:15 in the morning local time. The FBI said it was investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

At least six people died and more than 300 were injured when a man slammed a rented BMW SUV into a Christmas market in eastern Germany. The suspect, who was arrested at the scene, was a 50-year-old doctor originally from Saudi Arabia who had expressed anti-Muslim views and support for the far-right AfD party. In June 2026, he was sentenced to life in prison, with the court noting the severity of his crime, which more or less rules out the possibility of an early release.

A 62-year-old driver  rammed a small SUV into people exercising at a sports complex in southern China on November 11, 2024, killing 38 people in the country's deadliest act of mass homicide in years. Another 48 were injured. Authorities said the perpetrator was upset...
body.zh: 柏林骄傲活动中的袭击只是一长串将车辆用作武器的事件中的最新一起。近年来，美国、加拿大和中国也发生过类似的攻击。 德国首都的克里斯托弗街日活动每年都会吸引数千人参加，周六晚上，该活动遭到一名 21 岁嫌疑人的袭击，警方称该嫌疑人与柏林的“伊斯兰主义现场”有关。造成 1 人死亡、16 人受伤，嫌疑人 Abdul B. 逃离现场。 5 月初，德国东部城市莱比锡一辆汽车驶过人群，造成两人死亡、二十多人受伤。据描述，该案嫌疑人是一名 33 岁的德国国民和当地居民，警方认识他，但并未因相关罪行而认识他。 据警方和检察官称，2025 年，德国西南部城市曼海姆一名驾车者故意驾车冲撞人群，造成至少两人死亡、多人受伤。 当局确认嫌疑人是一名 40 岁的德国男子。执法部门当时排除了政治动机，尽管该男子因 2018 年在社交媒体平台上发表的评论而根据德国仇恨犯罪法缴纳了罚款。 去年2月，慕尼黑工会威尔第组织的一场示威活动中，一辆汽车被撞，导致一名37岁的妇女和她两岁的女儿丧生。一名 25 岁的阿富汗男子随后因谋杀以及企图谋杀袭击中受伤的其他数十人而接受审判。 2025 年元旦早些时候，一辆汽车冲撞了新奥尔良狂欢者的人群，造成 14 人死亡、数十人受伤。袭击发生在当地时间凌晨 3 点 15 分左右，车辆司机和两名警察在袭击发生后不久的交火中丧生。 联邦调查局表示，正在将此事件作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。 一名男子将一辆租来的宝马 SUV 撞向德国东部的圣诞市场，造成至少 6 人死亡、300 多人受伤。现场被捕的嫌疑人是一名来自沙特阿拉伯的 50 岁医生，曾表达反穆斯林观点并支持极右翼选择党。 2026 年 6 月，他被判处终身监禁，法院注意到他罪行的严重性，这或多或少排除了提前释放的可能性。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，一名 62 岁的司机驾驶一辆小型 SUV 撞向在中国南方一个体育场馆锻炼的人们，造成 38 人死亡，这是该国多年来最致命的大规模凶杀案。另有 48 人受伤。当局表示，肇事者情绪激动……

reflection.en: The repeated use of vehicles as weapons in public spaces highlights the destructive presence of evil in our world. In the face of such acts, Yahweh calls us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively overcome evil with good, fostering safety and compassion.
reflection.zh: 车辆在公共场所被反复用作武器，凸显了我们世界中破坏性邪恶的存在。面对此类行径，雅伟呼召我们不要被恶所胜，而是要积极地以善胜恶，培养安全与怜悯。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: From the strait of Hormuz to the North Sea, a global maritime war rages around us – and more than the price of oil is at stake | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 从霍尔木兹海峡到北海，一场全球海上战争在我们身边肆虐——不仅仅是石油价格受到威胁

body.en: The collapse of the rules-based order is not confined to the land: we’re imperilled as centuries of maritime cooperation sink beneath the waves The US military campaign to protect merchant shipping from Iranian attacks by asserting direct maritime control in the strait of Hormuz is not an idea unique to Donald Trump’s administration. Almost exactly 200 years ago, in the period 1825-27, a powerful US naval squadron led by Commodore John Rodgers was sent to the Mediterranean to defend American ships from the depredations of Greek corsairs and pirates. For all the new-minted republic’s brave talk of liberty, the US squadron did not assist Greece’s ongoing “regime change” struggle for independence from the Ottoman empire. Its sole, self-serving purpose was to defend US trade, markets and business interests. After abandoning his call for a people’s revolution in Tehran , this, too, is what Trump’s reckless war with Iran has now boiled down to. Simon Tisdall is a Guardian foreign affairs commentator Continue reading...

This offers a profound hope that even in the face of widespread tension,...

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

body.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正在迅速缩小与美国同行的差距，引发了特朗普政府的新威胁。随着知识产权盗窃的指控，紧张局势会升级吗？ 似乎一眨眼的功夫，中国在顶级人工智能 (AI) 领域就从落后美国五年变为仅落后几个月。 尽管包括 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 在内的美国企业已经花费了数千亿美元来推动人工智能的前沿发展，但中国却走了一条截然不同的道路。 面对美国对帮助人工智能实现最先进思维的高端芯片的限制，中国科技公司优先考虑了数十种基于“足够好”技术的开源人工智能模型。 这些平台，包括 DeepSeek、阿里巴巴的 Qwen 和小米的 MiMo，现已广泛部署在中国企业、政府服务和消费设备中。 作为缩小差距的最新迹象，中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 上周推出了 Kimi K3，该模型在关键基准测试上可与最先进的人工智能模型之一——Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 相媲美。 在某些测试中，Kimi K3 可以与 Claude 相媲美甚至超过 Claude，但其计算能力却要低得多，而成本却只是 Claude 的一小部分。 全球技术专家 Alvin W. Even amidst accusations and threats, seeking paths to de-escalation and mutual respect is vital for global stability. title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

title.en: Australia's favourite date to tie the knot — and what fresh marriage data reveals
title.zh: 澳大利亚最受欢迎的结婚日期——以及最新的婚姻数据揭示了什么

summary.en: Fewer Australians are marrying, while the divorce rate has edged higher.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Saturday 25 October was Australia's favourite day to say "I do" in 2025 — but new data suggests fewer couples are saying it.

Fewer Australians tied the knot last year than the year before, according to new figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

At the same time, more marriages are coming to an end, with the divorce rate ticking upward for the first time in several years, though ultimately remaining lower than it was 20 years ago.

The most popular wedding date in 2025 was Saturday 25 October — i.e. the symmetrical 25/10/25 — with 2,035 marriages.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

That's about 500 more than the runner-up, Saturday 22 November (22/11/25) — which had 1,527.

ABS data show there's somewhat of a trend towards more marriages on dates with numerical significance, though for some it could also be coincidence.

The least popular days were Christmas Day, with 51 weddings, Boxing Day with 54, New Year's Day with 57, and Tuesday 29 July with 61.

Spring dominated the wedding calendar, with most of the top ten dates falling in September, October and November. The rest were scattered across autumn.

Saturday remains, unsurprisingly, the nation's preferred wedding day — more than 52,000 marriages took place on a Saturday in 2025, and 45 of the year's most popular dates fell on one.

Friday came in second, with just over 21,000 marriages, led by Friday 10 October (10/10/25).

Zoom out further, and one day still reigns supreme: 10 November 2012 — the sequential 10/11/12.

That remains the most popular wedding date of the past 20 years, with 3,081 marriages recorded on that day — still comfortably ahead of the runner-up, 11 November 2011 (11/11/11), which had 2,614.

Beyond the calendar quirks, the broader numbers tell a clearer story: marriage is becoming less common in Australia.

There were 118,804 marriages registered in 2025 — 2,040 fewer than in 2024, a drop of 1.7 per cent.

That's in line with 2023's total (118,439), but still well above the pandemic-era lows of 2020 and 2021.

Adjusted for population, the marriage rate — the number of marriages per 1,000 people aged 16 and over — fell slightly to 5.3 in 2025, down from 5.5 in both 2023 and 2024.

Zoom out to 2005, where the marriage rate was 6.9, and the decline is even more stark.

The biggest drops came among 25-29 and 30-34 year-olds. No age group recorded an increase.

body.en:
Almost one million Origin Energy customers had their details accessed by hackers after a major data breach last week, the company has revealed.

On Tuesday, Origin said it had completed an initial review into the incident and identified that approximately 900,000 current and former customers' data was accessed by the hackers.

"To our customers, I am sorry. We don't take for granted the trust customers place in Origin and our safeguarding of their information," CEO Frank Calabria said in a statement.

Last week, the energy company announced it was the victim of the security incident , saying names, addresses, dates of birth, phone numbers and account information could all have been viewed.

Other potential details include the last four digits of credit cards, or the last three digits of bank accounts.

The company said it would be contacting affected customers first and was opening up a dedicated hotline for those concerned.

Origin said it had been trying to confirm the credibility of the threat since early July.

"We worked to confirm its credibility and potential impact; however, based on the information available, it was not assessed to be credible," Calabria said.

"On 22 July, new information emerged that indicated a potential security incident may have occurred. We acted immediately, providing updates to the market and notifying our customers as a precaution."

Origin, which has 4.8 million customer accounts in Australia and provides electricity, natural gas, LPG and internet services, said last week it did not believe the data obtained included credit card or bank details.

The company has also warned customers to be alert to a greater risk of scams that could arise from the data breach, advising customers to be wary of unexpected calls, emails or texts referring to their account.

Those who get such contact should independently contact Origin through numbers on official channels, it said, and do not provide passwords or personal information to anyone.

"We are acutely aware that others may exploit this incident, including by impersonating Origin or through other scam activity," Calabria said.

"We recommend that all our customers remain vigilant to suspicious activity and a heightened risk of scams.

Griffith University's Graeme Hughes, an expert on business and consumer issues, said the breach was unlikely to cause cases of payment fraud but marked a "social engineering problem".

"The last four digits for a card, a date of birth, and an authentic billing history are the exact trust signals a business uses to verify itself over the phone," Hughes told the Australian Associated Press.

body.en:
Australia's most powerful union figures have stepped down after almost a decade, saying a new generation of leaders was needed amid ongoing turbulence in the movement.

Sally McManus has been secretary of the Australian Council of Trade Unions (ACTU) since 2017, and Michele O'Neil its president since 2018.

The pair announced on Monday that they would leave their posts, making way for younger leaders to "take (the) movement forward".

''The ACTU's union affiliates will decide on the next leadership team, initially with the ACTU Executive filling the casual vacancies and then through an election at next year's congress, which will coincide with the ACTU's 100th anniversary," the pair said in a statement.

McManus will finish in the role at the end of August, while O'Neil will depart before the end of the year to ''assist with the leadership transition''.

While the pair have been praised for their work in securing deals for workers, the ACTU has been plagued by difficulties after alleged infiltration of criminals in the Construction, Forestry and Maritime Employees Union (CMFEU).

In 2024, McManus denied she knew of any of the behaviour in the Victorian branch, and also oversaw the ACTU's suspension of CFMEU divisions while it sorted itself out.

It was "essential" the sector emerged from that turbulent period under new leadership, O'Neil told ABC RN on Tuesday.

"Workers who work in the construction industry around this country, by and large, are hardworking, good people who work in tough and dangerous jobs, and they deserve a great union," she said.

"They deserve a union that is completely free of any violence or corruption or organised crime," she said.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese thanked the pair for their "tireless advocacy" for workers, and their support to him personally.

"It is fitting that Sally and Michele announce they're stepping down from their respective positions at a time when there have been significant wage increases in critical and long-undervalued sectors, the gender pay gap is at a record low and union membership is growing for the first time in decades", he said in a statement.

summary.en: The new premier's predecessor had consistently rejected calls for an inquiry into the state's scandal-plagued construction sector.

body.en:
New Victorian Premier Ben Carroll has declared he will lead his government in a "new direction", while distancing himself from his predecessors Jacinta Allan and Daniel Andrews.

In his first comments after being elected state Labor leader, Carroll also announced a royal commission into the construction sector, which has been marred by corruption allegations, and the strengthening of Victoria's anti-corruption watchdog.

"Let me make one thing very clear: I am not Daniel Andrews. I am not Jacinta Allan," he said on Tuesday afternoon, just hours after Allan's resignation.

The former deputy premier said "circumstances changed" in the six weeks since he promised Allan he would not challenge her for the top job. He thanked Allan for her service to the Labor Party and the state.

Carroll was elected to the top job after a chaotic party room meeting triggered by Allan's resignation, following her loss of party support amid dire polling.

Polls showed voters are frustrated with the high cost of living, rising state debt, infrastructure delays and alleged corruption on the state's Big Build projects.

Carroll was expected to secure the leadership unopposed before Victorian Attorney-General Sonya Kilkenny mounted a late challenge.

Under Labor rules, a contested leadership ballot must be put to a vote of the party's rank-and-file members.

The process could take weeks and would plunge the government into political instability just months before the November state election.

But after a lengthy meeting, during which both yelling and cheering could be heard at various stages, Carroll emerged as premier. State Transport Minister Gabrielle Williams was elected his deputy.

Announcing her resignation on Tuesday morning, Allan said it had been an honour to serve as leader.

"Thank you to the Victorian people. It has been the honour of my life to serve you as your premier. I stepped down after 1,036 days in this role. Not one of them wasted, not one of them easy."

Allan said she believed she would have won a rank-and-file membership vote, but said the process would have been damaging in the lead-up to the November election.

"More importantly, it puts the state in a position of uncertainty. That hurts the Victorian people, and I just won't do that. At the end of the day, I am, and always have been, a team player."

Allan reflected on her nearly three years as premier, saying her biggest priority had been tackling the cost of living.

"We not only made public transport free during a fuel crisis, we made public transport free for kids forever.

title.en: Who is Ben Carroll, Victoria's new premier?

summary.en: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has announced her resignation, and Ben Carroll, who previously pledged loyalty to her, is expected to succeed her.

body.en:
Ben Carroll has been sworn in as Victoria's new premier, but it was far from a straightforward change in power.

After Jacinta Allan announced her resignation as premier this morning, she seemed to express her support for Carroll to emerge as her successor.

However, reports have since emerged that she backed another contender in the subsequent caucus vote to elect a new leader.

While levels of party-room support seemed to guarantee that Carroll would become the next leader, a surprise curveball was thrown when Planning Minister Sonya Kilkenny challenged him for leadership, throwing the caucus meeting into chaos.

During Tuesday morning's meeting, Carroll faced a surprise leadership challenge from Kilkenny, who earned the support of 15 MPs — including Allan herself — according to The Age newspaper.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Three sources in the room told the paper Carroll had secured the support of more than two-thirds of caucus.

After a lengthy meeting that featured both yelling and applause behind closed doors, caucus whip Juliana Addison emerged to declare Carroll had been "unanimously" elected.

"I am delighted to announce that Ben Carroll has been unanimously elected for the Parliamentary Labor Party as our next Premier of Victoria," she said.

In a separate vote for deputy premier, Gabrielle Williams — briefly installed as interim leader after Allan's resignation — defeated Steve Dimopoulos, one of Allan's key backers.

Carroll has now been sworn in as premier, just four months out from the November state election.

During her resignation speech less than an hour before Tuesday's meeting, Allan said she welcomed Carroll as the next leader, but maintained she believed she would have won a party vote.

"After speaking with my colleagues overnight, I have made the difficult decision to step aside as leader of the Victorian state parliamentary Labor Party, and as premier of Victoria," Allan said at a press conference on Tuesday ahead of the caucus meeting.

"Should Ben Carroll emerge as our next Labor leader and Labor premier, he will have my congratulations and unqualified support."

Allan — who had initially refused to step down — said she was resigning because it was the "right thing" to do, but maintained she "would have won" a vote.

Carroll, Victoria's deputy premier, had been primed for a leadership challenge against Allan after a cross-factional delegation, including six ministers, told the premier she had lost majority support of the caucus.

summary.en: Australia could get its first new refinery in six decades, but an expert says it raises questions about oil production.
